stem: Which of these facts from the selection supports the idea that the local people embrace the Catatumbo Lightning?

options.label: F
options.text: This natural phenomenon is called the Relámpago del Catatumbo, or the Catatumbo Lightning.

options.label: G
options.text: The color of the lightning changes depending on the presence of dust, water, and various gases in the air.

options.label: H
options.text: The lightning is mentioned in poetry and songs; the state of Zulia even has a lightning bolt on its flag.

options.label: J
options.text: The mystery of what causes the lightning deepened when, beginning in January 2010, the lightning did not appear for a period of several months.
